claims.text: Chronic HDV in adults w.o cirrhosis or w compensated cirrhosis.
claims.quote: HEPCLUDEX is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection in adults without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis.

claims.text: Accelerated approval (↓ HDV RNA + ALT normalization);
claims.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a decrease in HDV RNA and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization
